**Finding submitted — deviation (high severity), NONCOMPETE.**

**What I found.** Section 6.1 (p0037), under the "Exclusivity" heading, binds *us* (the Company): we "shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including … companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled)."

**Why it fails the fallback, not just the preferred position:**
- **Scope** — "products substantially similar" and "companies similar to" is open-ended, not a named competing product (walk-away territory for undefined scope).
- **Duration** — tied to the term, but Section 4.1 (p0024) is a one-year term that auto-renews on each anniversary, so the restraint can run indefinitely beyond 12 months.
- **Carve-outs** — the only exception (Section 6.2, p0040) is a closeout-merchandise site; nothing permits our internal development or acquisitions.

**Direction check.** Section 6.3 (p0042) restricts HDI for the term plus two years — that runs in our favour, so I did not flag it. Section 10.7 survival (p0068) lists 6.3, 7, 9 and 10, not 6.1, so no survival tail attaches to our covenant.

**The edit.** One surgical replacement in p0037 that strikes only our prohibition and the now-redundant "Except as provided in Section 6.2" lead-in, leaving intact HDI's exclusive right to the "Deerskin" branded site (the core bargain) and Section 6.2 as a standalone retained right. No other provision cross-references Section 6.1, so nothing dangles. The comment offers the narrowed fallback if HDI needs protection.
